root_cause: Production Source Snapshot acquired the JIT Netlify bridge before giving Netlify's already-configured native Git integration time to publish the exact main SHA. The bridge correctly authenticated GitHub OIDC, but its Supabase-side Composio project authority could not discover the active Netlify MCP connection because that connection is PRIVATE. The eager bridge call therefore returned HTTP 420 and made a healthy native production delivery appear red.
prevention: Use Netlify native Git integration as the canonical primary production authority and prove it through bounded exact-SHA release.json readback before any fallback side effect.
Acquire GitHub OIDC and JIT Netlify MCP authority only after native Git exact-SHA readback times out.
Keep one exact-source MCP upload fallback; do not maintain a second linked-build trigger lane.
On JIT bridge failure, classify the provider error explicitly, re-read production once for a deployment race, and fail closed if neither native production nor fallback authority is proven.
